title: [plugins.decision-mail] config
description: The channel mailbox and its sender allowlist. Passwords and the channel key are plugin secrets, never config.

address.description: The channel mailbox address requests are sent from and replies arrive at (user@domain).

notify_to.description: The operator address requests are mailed to; a reused-token warning goes here too.

allowed_senders.description: Addresses whose replies are accepted. Everything else is dropped without a reply.

authserv_id.description: The mailbox provider's Authentication-Results authserv-id (for example mx.google.com); only its topmost stamp is read.

channel.description: The registered decision channel name submissions use.

key_epoch.description: The channel's current key epoch, as `orbit decision channel list` shows it; tokens are minted under it.

plus_addressing.description: Put the token in Reply-To as <local>+<token>@<domain>.

max_messages.description: Mails one poll handles at most.

dashboard_url.description: Link closing each mail; {task_id} and {request_id} are filled in.
